texts.zh:
压力的变化既突然又剧烈；球体抵达的地方似乎是浩瀚海洋的深处。这里一片漆黑，我们的仪器没有探测到任何生命、漂浮沉积物或颗粒物质的迹象。

根据水压判断，我们在表面以下极深处。
texts.en:
The change in pressure was as sudden as it was violent; the Sphere arrived in the depths of what appears to be a vast ocean. All is dark. Our instruments show no signs of life, floating sediment, or particulate matter.

Judging by the high water pressure, we are somewhere deep below the surface.

texts.zh:
好像出了什么问题。

我们在水中穿行了数个小时，但周围的环境一成不变。

似乎有一种我们引擎无法克服的力整影响着我们。

我们也许可以通过短距跃迁的方式克服。或者我们可以离开球体，把自己附着在低密度的充气式物体上，这样就有可能会浮到表面。
texts.en:
Something is wrong.

We have been traveling through the water for hours, but have seen no change in our surroundings.

There is some force acting on us that our engines cannot overcome.

We may be able to overpower it with a short jump. Alternatively, if we exit the Sphere and attach ourselves to low density inflatables we may simply float to the surface.

texts.zh:
好像出了什么问题。

我们在水中穿行了数个小时，但周围的环境一成不变。

舵手认为，可能有一种作用在我们身上的力让引擎无法客服。他建议我们试试短距离跃迁。或者自行离开球体，把自己附着在低密度的充气式物体上，这样就有可能会浮到表面。
texts.en:
Something is wrong.

We have been traveling through the water for hours, but have seen no change in our surroundings.

The helmsman believes there is some force acting on us that our engines cannot overcome. He recommends we try a short jump. Alternatively, if we exit the Sphere and attach ourselves to low density inflatables we may simply float to the surface.

label.zh: 穿好抗压服，我们游上去。
穿好抗压服，我们游上去。

texts.zh:
短距跃迁生效了。我们出现在了靠近表面的区域。在突破水面后，我们发现我们事实上处于一个真空宇宙中行星大小的空泡中。

我们之前的速度完全无法脱离其引力束缚。
texts.en:
The short jump seems to have worked. We have appeared near the surface. After breaking through, we have discovered that we were in fact inside of a planet-sized bubble in the vacuum of space.

Our previous speeds were not enough to break through its gravitational forces.

texts.zh:
我们周围的空间看起来像是一瓶恒星大小的液体在低重力下爆炸，行星大小的微晶液体气泡在四周漂浮。附近有一颗恒星，我们正无力地围绕着它运动。它看起来非常古老、暗淡而冰冷。

而此处还有别的东西。虽说不是一颗恒星，却有恒星般大小。它是由无数互相交织的碎片组成，就像一个无比巨大的3D拼图。扫描显示，它是由许多珍贵的金属和材料构成的，这些物质和它所围绕的恒星中所蕴含的物质完全一致。很有可能其中一者诞生自另一者之中，或是具有相同的起源。

仔细观察会发现，那些碎片正在缓慢浮动。偶尔会有一个新的巨大液体泡泡从这座构造中泄出。

如果它有生命，那看起来还没有注意到我们。
texts.en:
The space around us looks as if a star-sized bottle of liquid exploded in low gravity. Planetoid-sized bubbles of crystalline liquid float all around us. There is a nearby star which we are weakly orbiting. It looks old, dark, and cold.

There is something else. It is not a star, but just as big. It is constructed of massive interconnected fragments, like a 3-dimensional puzzle on a gigantic scale. Scans determine it to be composed of various precious metals and minerals that are nearly identical to that of what is inside of the star it orbits. It is likely one formed from the other, or from a common source.

On closer inspection, the pieces are slowly moving and shifting. Occasionally, a large bubble of new liquid pours out from its architecture.

If it is alive, it has not seemed to notice us.

texts.zh:
如此巨大的构造存在却不需要任何管理员和维护，它必然拥有某种程度的自主性。

我们扫描了所有的音频频段但一无所获。

它只会释放持续不断令人恶寒的哀嚎。

我们目前准备尝试用所有已知的语言在该频段下发出广播以期进行通讯。

我们该说些什么呢？
texts.en:
For such a massive mechanism to exist without caretakers or maintenance it must have some form of autonomy.

We cycled through all available audio frequencies, then found something.

It is emitting a constant, terrible wailing.

We are currently prepared to broadcast a message in every known language tuned to this frequency in an attempt to communicate.

What should we say?

texts.zh:
如此巨大的构造存在却不需要任何管理员和维护，它必然拥有某种程度的自主性。

我们扫描了所有的音频频段但一无所获。

它只会释放持续不断令人恶寒的哀嚎。

要不是舵手默默地切断了这个信号，恐怕船员们的精神很快就濒临崩溃了。

我们目前准备尝试用所有已知的语言在该频段下发出广播以期进行通讯。

我们该说些什么呢？
texts.en:
For such a massive mechanism to exist without caretakers or maintenance it must have some form of autonomy.

We cycled through all available audio frequencies, then found something.

It is emitting a constant, terrible wailing.

The crew's senses quickly became overwhelmed until the helmsman cut the feed without a word.

We are currently prepared to broadcast a message in every known language tuned to this frequency in an attempt to communicate.

What should we say?

texts.zh:
这个物体突然……醒了。它的碎片被向外拉开，以难以置信的速度开始旋转。它的重力井也陡然骤增，我们以极高的加速度被拉了过去。

一颗如同小型恒星一般的火球从它的碎片之间涌现。这个熔炉只出现在物体的其中一侧，它缓缓转向我们，向我们释放出狂暴的炽热。

一股电磁辐射脉冲突然爆发，让我们的船颤抖起来。控制台上的每个警报都响了起来，或者干脆发出了故障信号。

船体到达了材料极限。

我们赶紧拉动紧急锚链，尽可能取回了样板。

不管它到底是什么，似乎这超出了我们所能干涉的范畴。
texts.en:
The object has suddenly... awoken. Its pieces have pulled outward and are rotating at an incredible speed. Its gravity well has dramatically increased, and we have been pulled forward at high acceleration.

A fiery sphere, like a small star, has emerged from within its pieces. This furnace, present on only one side of the object, has spun slowly toward us and is emitting a violent heat in our direction.

A pulse of electromagnetic radiation then burst forth, and our vessel shuddered. Every alarm on the console activated, or signaled in error.

Our vessel has reached its material limit.

We have pulled the emergency anchor, and are returning with what specimens we can.

Whatever it is, it seems beyond our abilities to interfere.

一股电磁辐射脉冲突然爆发，让我们的船颤抖起来。控制台上的每个警报都响了起来，或者干脆发出了故障信号——而翻译功能却维持正常。

我们收到了一个用二进制编码写成的，许多我们已知语言短语：“悲痛。走开。”

船体到达了材料极限。

我们赶紧拉动紧急锚链，尽可能取回了样板。

不管它到底是什么，似乎这超出了我们所能干涉的范畴。
texts.en:
The object has suddenly... awoken. Its pieces have pulled outward and are rotating at an incredible speed. Its gravity well has dramatically increased, and we have been pulled forward at high acceleration.

A fiery sphere, like a small star, has emerged from within its pieces. This furnace, present on only one side of the object, has spun slowly toward us and is emitting a violent heat in our direction.

A pulse of electromagnetic radiation then burst forth, and our vessel shuddered. Every alarm on the console activated, or signaled in error - except for the translator.

A phrase was registered in several of our known languages, written in binary code: "Sorrow. Leave us."

Our vessel has reached its material limit.

We have pulled the emergency anchor, and are returning with what specimens we can.

Whatever it is, it seems beyond our abilities to interfere.

船体到达了材料极限。

texts.en:
The object has suddenly... awoken. Its pieces have pulled outward and are rotating at an incredible speed. Its gravity well has dramatically increased, and we have been pulled forward at high acceleration.

A fiery sphere, like a small star, has emerged from within its pieces. This furnace, present on only one side of the object, has spun slowly toward us and is emitting a violent heat in our direction.

A pulse of electromagnetic radiation then burst forth, and our vessel shuddered. Every alarm on the console activated, or signaled in error - except for the translator.

A phrase was registered in several of our known languages, written in binary code: "No hope. I mourn. You leave. Now."

Our vessel has reached its material limit.

We have pulled the emergency anchor, and are returning with what specimens we can.

Whatever it is, it seems beyond our abilities to interfere.

texts.zh:
我们慢慢地靠近，小心地避开周围的水泡。

这个物体一直在运动。它的各个部件互相摩擦所产生的热量足以熔化大多数已知的金属。据我们的理解，它的核心是完全熔化的状态。

我们正在向计算机上传它的结构细节以进行进一步研究。
texts.en:
We approached slowly, carefully navigating around nearby bubbles of water.

 The object is in constant motion. The heat generated by the friction of the interwoven pieces is enough to melt most known metals. Its core, from what we can tell, is completely molten.

We are uploading its structural details to our computers for further study.

texts.zh:
我们部署了超长缆线，通过特殊的气闸离开了球体。

我们都将紧急浮标充气后，低密度将我们以惊人的速度带到了海面。

一路上我们的抗压服过滤器收集到了非常高浓度的星界纤维丝线。

当我们穿着笨重的抗压服刺破水面时，发现其实我们身处一个真空宇宙中行星大小的泡泡里。

裂隙探球的密度过高无法逃脱这里的引力。

我们向球体发回了信号，遥控其短距跃迁到我们的位置附近。
texts.en:
Remote tethers were deployed, and we have exited the Sphere through the specialized airlock.

We each inflated our emergency buoys as briefed and, with surprising speed, our lower densities raised us to the surface.

Along the way, the filters on our suit gathered some very highly concentrated threads of astral fabric.

After our bulky suits pierced through the surface, we discovered that we were in fact inside of a planet-sized bubble in the vacuum of space.

The Rift Sphere's density was too high to overcome the gravitational forces present here.

We have radioed back to the Sphere and ordered a short jump near our location.
